description: Returns the current state of one credential request: its stage, destination, risk, and the outcome once it is finished. Never returns credential material. Reads only — use secret_store to create a request.

request_id.description: Identifier returned by secret_store or secret_revise.

wait_seconds.description: Block until the request reaches a terminal state or this many seconds elapse. Omit or use 0 to return immediately.

name: secret_status
title: Check a credential request
